params.prompt: A bottom sheet over a dimmed home screen: the glowing speech-bubble mascot 'Hi' at the top with a friendly expression and the line 'Ben Hi, yapay zekâ asistanın.'. A highlighted suggestion card 'Bugünkü önerim: Hikâyeye devam' with a small 'Neden?' caption and a reason line, and a yellow pill button. A 2x2 grid of quick action tiles with icons ('Hikâye', 'Kelime tekrarı', 'Defter', 'Konu setleri'). A 'Bu hafta' row of three small stat tiles. Rounded top corners 20px, drag handle. High-fidelity mobile app UI mockup, single iPhone screen, portrait, flat front view, no device frame, for 'hiVelzon', an English-learning app built around an animated coastal mystery story. Design system: warm sand background (#F7F1E6), white rounded cards (12px corners) with soft warm shadows, deep sea blue (#1F4E79) for titles and accents, lighthouse yellow (#F2B33D) pill-shaped primary buttons, evening orange (#E98A3C) small accents, small caps orange labels, rounded friendly bold headings (Nunito style) and clean body text (Inter style), 8px grid, generous whitespace, playful but calm, illustrated graphic-novel art inside shaped headers (wave or diagonal cut). Bottom navigation with 5 tabs: 'Ana Sayfa', 'Keşfet', 'Hikâye', 'Konuş', 'Profil', and a small round glowing speech-bubble mascot with two friendly eyes floating at bottom-right above the tab bar. Turkish UI text, legible, minimal. No ads, no hearts/lives, no timers, no leaderboards, no real brand logos.
